symptom: `mxcli syntax` teaches spellings `check` warns on as deprecated, so an agent copying the reference gets MDL-DEPRnnn: `NOT NULL [ERROR 'msg']` (MDL-DEPR021, write `error message`), a named data grid `COLUMN name (` (MDL-DEPR005), `CREATE [OR REPLACE]` for microflow/nanoflow/layout/navigation (MDL-DEPR001), `MODEL accepts these keys` for `alter settings runtime` (MDL-DEPR555), the MOVE doctype list's QUEUE / REST CLIENT / ODATA CLIENT / ODATA SERVICE / MODEL, and `Date` as an attribute type (MDL-DEPR160, refused under mdl 1); the microflow workflow actions (`$Wf = call workflow M.WF ($Obj);`, get workflow data, workflow operation, lock/unlock …) had no topic at all
cause: TestExamplesParse proved each Example parses but never ran the validator, and the Syntax field (metasyntax) was checked only against hand lists of retired spellings — every deprecation added to the registry after a topic was written left that topic stale
file: `cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_{domain_model,misc,page,microflow,workflow}.go`; guards in `cmd/mxcli/syntax/example_parses_test.go` (deprecationErrors, container wrappers) and `cmd/mxcli/syntax/syntax_deprecations_test.go` (registry-driven fingerprints)
insight: Drive the guard from `mdl/deprecation`, not a hand list. Examples: run `executor.ValidateProgram` + `ApplyDeprecationPolicy(Error)` in EVERY context a block parses in, and host fragments in their containers (datagrid, dataview) because MDL-DEPR005 only fires on a column inside a grid. Syntax: diff each entry's Example against its CanonicalExample to get the changed tokens, then widen with context until the pattern holds a keyword, does not end on a name (`Ready comment` matched the prose "a comment"), and matches none of the known-clean corpus (all CanonicalExamples + every validated Example) — that corpus is what keeps `image collection` or `type:` from flagging canonical text. Drop `[`/`]` when lexing or `NOT NULL [ERROR 'msg']` escapes the pattern. Prose in `--` comments is not matched, so the MOVE doctype list and the RUNTIME prose had to be found by hand with `check`. Revert-proofed: restoring `ERROR 'msg'`, `COLUMN name (` or `head($L)` each fails with the code.
